# write_throughput bench summary (generated by summarize_bench.py)

Columns: write ms = duration of the writer.write() call per frame, all cameras pooled; tick->written = scheduled capture tick to write return; grab late = how late the camera loop picked up its tick (inloop models show writer stalls here); our CPU %/cam = all bench process CPU / duration / cams (100 = one logical CPU); sys busy % = psutil system-wide busy share of all logical CPUs; MsMpEng = Defender engine CPU seconds during the run; disk write GB = PhysicalDrive write bytes during the run (the lazy writer may still hold data at the end of short runs).
